_comment: SUPERSEDED by _sdewl_on30.json — do NOT grade from this arm.  Two reasons:
(1) its run (runs/golden_0729/sdewl_on) predates the SPEC §3b correction-frame fix
and the §5b channel search, so it built ZERO rows and silently dropped 961
station-epochs on a throwing shared-column lookup — see SPEC §10;
(2) it also lowers eigen_threads / parallel_max_threads to 6 while the baseline
ran at 8, making the spectrum comparison a two-treatment test.
Kept only as the provenance record of the first attempt.
